text: I struggle to stay focused on a task. I feel invincible and believe I can do anything. Then I feel empty and struggle to get out of bed. I have repeated stretches like this with returns to my usual self.

text: After these periods I crash into deep depression. My mind is moving too fast to keep up with. I feel much more excited and energetic than usual. I often forget what I was about to do. text: توقفت عن رؤية أصدقائي وأعزل نفسي. أستمر في تأجيل ما يجب علي فعله.
